name: consumption
description: Aggregates energy consumption time-series for downstream meters of the selected nodes.

requirements.description: This plugin analyses energy balance (consumption) for a given asset and its downstream meters.
agent_directives: Use this plugin when the user asks for 'consumption', 'energy balance', or 'total power' downstream of an asset.
Expect a time-series response showing delivered and received kWh.
Navigate the map to the found downstream meters if requested.
